entities.name: Kellan Boldt
entities.description: A Prodigal Sorcerer, once son and heir to the Duchy of Kelsh on Dominaria.

entities.name: Enthril
entities.description: A ship-mage who helped Kellan against the pirates and vanished after casting a spell on the ship.

entities.name: Tolarian Academy
entities.description: School on Tolaria West where Kellan was accepted to study.

entities.name: Duchy of Kelsh
entities.description: Dominarian duchy of which Kellan was heir.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane where Kellan's story takes place.

entities.name: Scourge of Fleets
entities.description: A giant kraken that attacked Kellan and Enthril's ship.

entities.name: Perimeter of the Dire Waves
entities.description: A deadly storm-tossed area of the sea that pirates would not cross.

events.summary: Kellan is apprenticed to Archmage Ghavos and trained with a sextant as a focus.
events.quote: Kellan was apprenticed to Archmage Ghavos and was trained in the use of a sextant as a focus.

events.summary: Kellan's ship is assailed by pirates on the way to Tolaria West; Kellan and Enthril hold them off until the ship crosses the Perimeter of the Dire Waves.
events.quote: his ship was assailed by pirates during the voyage

events.summary: A giant kraken smashes the ship; Enthril warps the wreck into a hot-air balloon and disappears.
events.quote: A badly wounded Enthril cast a chaotic Eternal Dominion spell

events.summary: Kellan lets the balloon drift past the Tolarian Academy into the unknown, seeking adventure.
events.quote: Kellan let the course of the balloon change and headed past the school and into the unknown.

relations.quote: Kellan was apprenticed to Archmage Ghavos

relations.note: Son and heir to the Duchy.
relations.quote: once son and heir to the Duchy of Kelsh on the plane of Dominaria
